number.description: exact rational p/q, or a decimal with up to 30 significant digits

R.description: one entry per field, source order

basis.description: Hermite normal form of the saturated integer kernel; rows = U(1) generators, columns = fields in the theory's order

terms.description: the full refined index with constant term 1: [t milli-exponent, y power, flavor exponents in the flavor basis, coefficient]

identity.description: sha256 of t_order, the unrefined index below t^t_order and the central charges a, c rounded half-even to 25 significant digits (model.identity_of_fixed_point) - the key of the fixed point for the database, independent of the flavor basis; null without an index or central charges and null for a flagged (ambiguous) theory. The enumeration's equivalence (enumerate.equivalent) compares the unrefined index and the central charges within a relative tolerance of 10^-25: equal identities are neither sufficient nor necessary for it (they disagree at rounding boundaries; on the checked records the two gave the same marks). Complete retrieval of a record's candidates uses the unrefined-index key (enumerate.fixed_point_key, computable from the stored index) followed by that predicate and the rank rule, as the enumeration does; an identity lookup is an optimization only with that fallback

analysis.description: results of the post-processing that are neither operators nor the verdict

consistency.description: C1/C2 of the old Index check alone, before C1'/C3 and the central-charge bounds

dim3.description: t^6 coefficient of the unrefined scalar part of the reduced index

susy_enhanced.description: C3 at j = 1/2: extra supercurrent signal

unlisted_positive_terms.description: positive terms of the F-term-substituted scalar part at 0 < E < 6 that the inherited entry rule does not list as relevant (net coefficient zero at their own flavor)

negative_power_terms.description: positive terms with a negative power of a field (a conjugate-fermion letter of a field outside the superpotential): kept out of every operator list
